cues.text: Checking clothes when the customer drops them off protects the customer, the clothes, and the shop.
One. Empty every pocket. A pen left in a pocket can ruin a whole load. Give money, cards, and keys back to the customer.
Two. Check the buttons. Note any that are missing, cracked, or loose.
Three. Look for holes, tears, moth holes, and worn spots, especially at the elbows, collar, and hems.
Four. Look for stains, and ask the customer what they are.
Five. Belts, hoods, fur collars, and removable linings. Tag them too, or give them back to the customer.
Six. Count the pieces together with the customer.
Found something? Show it to the customer before they leave.
Then tap Stain or Defective on the ticket, and write a short note, like missing button, left cuff.
This way everyone knows it was there before we cleaned it.
